subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported attachment-context opt-out, and should that policy be Feishu-specific or a shared channel media-ingestion setting?
rationale: The reported key is not a current documented config contract, and implementing equivalent behavior adds config/default semantics that affect how Feishu media reaches model context.

options.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented top-level and per-account Feishu option that defaults to current download behavior and sends only placeholders when enabled.

options.title: Create Shared Media Policy
options.body: Use this issue to define one channel-wide attachment-ingestion policy if maintainers want consistent behavior across transports.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Clarify that Feishu currently supports `mediaMaxMb` only and intentionally does not provide a file-content ignore switch.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented top-level and per-account Feishu option that defaults to current download behavior and sends only placeholders when enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the strongest recent Feishu media/docs ownership signal from PR 47968, which touched the exact media and docs surfaces likely affected by this decision.
